sourceFingerprintAlgorithm: sha256 over the covered paths in DECLARED ORDER; each path contributes <repo-relative path> NUL <64-hex sha256 of the file's RAW BYTES> NUL; per-file digest = script/m24/portability.ts sha256File() (node:crypto, no process spawn)

differential.sampling: all reverse-dependency edges of the fixture root (the fixture IS the sample, none skipped); L3 answers usage sites since M55.T3 (incoming, non-declaration) — no direction correction needed; containment delta verified separately
differential.nestedDelta: nested1 counted in impact via owner cascade (a flat L3 location too, as a distinct edge)

limitations: totalCountIfKnown is computed by an independent bounded COUNT under the same containment rule; it counts distinct caller symbols, not call sites.
Impact depth cap mirrors the engine (5); deeper chains exist but are declared out of budget.
Latency measured headless (component + engine); in-editor regime is measured by the editor legs.
